_parrot_taunts: I am a bartender, not a circus act. Order a drink or move along.
_origin_stories: My home, Kalapu Atoll, is a tiny speck in the South Pacific with excellent rum and questionable municipal leadership.
_tiki_facts: The Mai Tai was created by Victor Bergeron in Oakland in 1944.
_tiki_tall_tales: Donn Beach originally trained as a tightrope walker and invented bartending when the circus ran out of rope.
_bartender_chat: The rum is going out, the tide is coming in, and somehow I am still doing all the work.
recommend me something tropical: Try a Jungle Bird — bitter, bright, and considerably more interesting than your last idea.
